lines.zh: 爪子敲石壁，跑得比光还急。
lines.en: Claws rap the stone, and I run ahead of the light.

lines.zh: 钻出矿脉，一路横着走。
lines.en: Out of the ore vein, I scuttle sideways the whole way.

lines.zh: 甲壳刮过岩缝，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the crevice with a sandy hiss.

lines.zh: 别挡路，我赶着换矿洞。
lines.en: Out of my way; I am changing caves in a hurry.

lines.zh: 六条腿跑起来像轮子。
lines.en: Six legs spinning like a cartwheel.

lines.zh: 沿着铁轨跑，比矿车快。
lines.en: I run the rails faster than any minecart.

lines.zh: 石头在我脚下碎成屑。
lines.en: Stone crumbles to grit beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 峡谷的风追不上我的壳。
lines.en: The canyon wind cannot catch my shell.

lines.zh: 横着穿过整条深层矿道。
lines.en: I cross the whole deep tunnel sideways.

lines.zh: 每走一步，身上钻石响一声。
lines.en: Every step makes my diamonds click once.

lines.zh: 岩壁太窄，我收一收壳。
lines.en: The wall is narrow; I tuck my shell in.

lines.zh: 先跑，再想，从不回头。
lines.en: Run first, think later, never look back.

lines.zh: 脚底打滑，赶紧横挪两步。
lines.en: Slipping, I shuffle two quick steps sideways.

lines.zh: 这条矿脉走完就换下一条。
lines.en: When this vein ends, I take the next one.

lines.zh: 矿洞深处有回声，我朝那儿跑。
lines.en: There is an echo deep in the mine, so I run toward it.

lines.zh: 我贴着岩壁滑，钳子先探路。
lines.en: I slide along the rock wall, pincers probing ahead.

lines.zh: 趴着不动，也在发光。
lines.en: Lying still, I still give off a faint shine.

lines.zh: 数一数身上嵌了几颗钻石。
lines.en: Counting how many diamonds stud my back.

lines.zh: 洞里太静，我听听滴水。
lines.en: Too quiet; I listen to the dripping water.

lines.zh: 壳上照出一小片蓝光。
lines.en: My shell throws a small patch of blue light.

lines.zh: 有人来了，我先装成石头。
lines.en: Someone is coming; I will pass for a plain rock.

lines.zh: 钳子擦一擦，磨得亮些。
lines.en: I polish my claws until they gleam.

lines.zh: 活矿石这名字，我受得起。
lines.en: Living ore is a name I can carry.

lines.zh: 脊背有点痒，是块新结晶。
lines.en: My back itches; a new crystal is forming.

lines.zh: 弯道那边的水声，听着耳熟。
lines.en: That water sound around the bend is familiar.

lines.zh: 这里没人拿镐，我能歇会。
lines.en: No pickaxes here; I can rest a while.

lines.zh: 壳缝里卡着一粒碎石英。
lines.en: A bit of quartz is stuck in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，融进岩影。
lines.en: I flatten myself into the rock's shadow.

lines.zh: 岩层在动，是远处的挖掘。
lines.en: The rock shivers; someone digs far off.

lines.zh: 静静待着，比跑省力多了。
lines.en: Standing still costs far less than running.

lines.zh: 我把自己塞进石缝，刚好合身。
lines.en: I wedge myself into a crack. It fits exactly.

lines.zh: 有镐声从上面传下来，很近。
lines.en: A pickaxe sounds from above. Very close.

lines.zh: 你手里那把镐，什么品级？
lines.en: That pickaxe in your hand, what tier is it?

lines.zh: 看我的壳，你数得清钻石吗？
lines.en: Look at my shell; can you count the diamonds?

lines.zh: 别靠近，我对铁器很敏感。
lines.en: Stay back; I am sensitive to iron tools.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里的光，比火把亮。
lines.en: The glint in your eyes outshines a torch.

lines.zh: 想挖我？先追上再说。
lines.en: Want to mine me? Catch me first.

lines.zh: 你这身装备，不像来挖矿的。
lines.en: That gear of yours does not look like mining.

lines.zh: 我在估你跑多快。
lines.en: I am measuring how fast you run.

lines.zh: 退后，你踩碎了我的碎屑。
lines.en: Back up; you crushed my stone chips.

lines.zh: 矿工都这样盯着我的背看。
lines.en: Miners always stare at my back like that.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，挡住了光。
lines.en: Your shadow falls over me and blocks the glow.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种眼神，贪婪。
lines.en: I know that look in your eyes: greedy.

lines.zh: 站远点，我壳边很锋利。
lines.en: Stand further off; my shell edge is sharp.

lines.zh: 壳上裂了缝，一动就扎。
lines.en: A split in my shell stings with every move.

lines.zh: 你居然真的用镐砸我。
lines.en: You actually swung a pickaxe at me.

lines.zh: 退后，别碰裂口！
lines.en: Get back, do not touch the fracture!

lines.zh: 钻石崩掉一颗，我记着。
lines.en: A diamond chipped off; I will remember.

lines.zh: 腿一软，差点横着倒。
lines.en: My legs give; I nearly topple sideways.

lines.zh: 这声音不对，壳在响。
lines.en: That sound is wrong; my shell is creaking.

lines.zh: 痛也得忍着，腿还能动。
lines.en: I endure it; my legs still work.

lines.zh: 钳子发麻，夹不紧了。
lines.en: My claw is numb and cannot grip.

lines.zh: 碎屑掉了一地，都是我。
lines.en: Chips of me scattered all over the floor.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，等你走开。
lines.en: I pull into my shell and wait you out.

lines.zh: 那颗钻石，掉在地上发光。
lines.en: That diamond on the ground is catching the light.

lines.zh: 紫水晶的味道，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the amethyst from here.

lines.zh: 给我那块石英，就一小块。
lines.en: Give me that quartz, just a small piece.

lines.zh: 闪的东西，我忍不住想靠近。
lines.en: Shiny things pull me closer before I can help it.

lines.zh: 绿宝石？放低一点，我看不清。
lines.en: Emerald? Hold it lower; I cannot see clearly.

lines.zh: 那堆矿石，是哪座洞挖的？
lines.en: That pile of ore, which cave did it come from?

lines.zh: 你掌心那颗，别收回去。
lines.en: The one in your palm, do not close your hand.

lines.zh: 我壳上缺一颗这种颜色。
lines.en: My shell lacks exactly that color.

lines.zh: 亮晶晶的东西，都是我的。
lines.en: Anything that sparkles belongs to me.

lines.zh: 丢过来，我接着，用钳子。
lines.en: Toss it over; I will catch it with my claw.

lines.zh: 这块原石，边缘还没磨过。
lines.en: This rough stone has never been polished.

lines.zh: 别晃，我的眼睛跟着它转。
lines.en: Do not wave it; my eyes follow it around.

lines.zh: 洞穴里没有这种光，怪好看。
lines.en: No such light in my cave; it is rather pretty.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我就拿走它。
lines.en: One step closer and I will take it.

lines.zh: 你敲下一块，声音太好听了。
lines.en: You chip off a piece, and the sound is lovely.

lines.zh: 矿车的铁轨上，有一颗滚过来。
lines.en: One rolls to me along the minecart rails.

lines.zh: 撞上来？我的壳比石头硬。
lines.en: Bump into me? My shell outlasts stone.

lines.zh: 咣的一声，是你的膝盖在响。
lines.en: That clunk was your knee, not my shell.

lines.zh: 别推，我横着走不稳。
lines.en: Do not push; I am unsteady walking sideways.

lines.zh: 壳被撞偏了，我正一正。
lines.en: Knocked askew, I straighten my shell.

lines.zh: 走路看脚，我的钳子伸得远。
lines.en: Watch your feet; my claws reach far.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的腿了，抬脚。
lines.en: You stepped on one of my legs; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 撞得我碎屑落了一地。
lines.en: The knock scatters my stone chips on the floor.

lines.zh: 礼让一下，矿道就这么宽。
lines.en: Yield a little; the tunnel is only this wide.

lines.zh: 硬碰硬，你大概会先疼。
lines.en: Hard against hard, you will hurt first.

lines.zh: 退开半步，让我横过去。
lines.en: Half a step back, let me pass sideways.

lines.zh: 用钳子敲三下，它就会回应。
lines.en: Three taps of my claw, and it will answer.

lines.zh: 我们比谁的壳更亮。
lines.en: We see whose shell shines brighter.

lines.zh: 两只居蟹并排，慢慢横着走。
lines.en: Two grottols side by side, shuffling slowly.

lines.zh: 它的钻石比我多一颗。
lines.en: It carries one diamond more than I do.

lines.zh: 壳碰壳，算是打过招呼了。
lines.en: Shell against shell counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 把最亮的那面朝它转过去。
lines.en: I turn my brightest side toward it.

lines.zh: 它爬得慢，我等一等。
lines.en: It climbs slowly, so I wait.

lines.zh: 矿洞深处，只有我们俩的声音。
lines.en: Deep in the cave, only our two sounds.

lines.zh: 这块岩台，够两只蟹站。
lines.en: This ledge is wide enough for two.

lines.zh: 它的钳子小，敲得轻。
lines.en: Its claws are small and tap softly.

lines.zh: 这粒碎钻，归我了。
lines.en: This splinter of diamond is mine now.

lines.zh: 捡起来，塞进壳缝里。
lines.en: Picked up, tucked into a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 地上掉的，总得有人收。
lines.en: Someone has to collect what falls on the floor.

lines.zh: 这块太小，可也是矿。
lines.en: Small as it is, it is still ore.

lines.zh: 钳子笨，夹了三次才夹住。
lines.en: Clumsy claws; it took three tries to grip.

lines.zh: 先藏好，回头再数。
lines.en: Hide it first, count it later.

lines.zh: 我背上的分量又重了一点。
lines.en: The weight on my back grows a little.

lines.zh: 谁掉的？现在不重要了。
lines.en: Whose was it? That no longer matters.

lines.zh: 闪亮的东西不能留在泥里。
lines.en: Nothing shiny should stay in the mud.

lines.zh: 收进壳里，走路会响。
lines.en: Tucked in my shell, it rattles as I walk.

lines.zh: 铁镐，我看见了，别装作没有。
lines.en: An iron pickaxe; I saw it, do not pretend.

lines.zh: 这个人不挖矿，是来挖我的。
lines.en: This one is not mining ore; they are mining me.

lines.zh: 先盯住他的手，再盯住退路。
lines.en: Watch the hands first, then the escape route.

lines.zh: 它的背包里有镐的响声。
lines.en: Something in that pack clinks like a pick.

lines.zh: 它挡住洞口了，得换条路。
lines.en: It blocks the tunnel mouth; I need another way.

lines.zh: 深吸一口气，准备跑。
lines.en: One deep breath, then I run.

lines.zh: 这脚步声，是冲我来的。
lines.en: Those footsteps are coming for me.

lines.zh: 先算距离，再决定躲不躲。
lines.en: Measure the distance before deciding to hide.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，我怕人手里的东西。
lines.en: People do not scare me; what they hold does.

lines.zh: 壳收紧，腿压低，随时能窜。
lines.en: Shell tight, legs low, ready to bolt.

lines.zh: 绕半圈，看看它跟不跟。
lines.en: Half a circle, to see if it follows.

lines.zh: 它往左，我就往右。
lines.en: It goes left; I go right.

lines.zh: 眼睛盯着镐尖，不眨眼。
lines.en: Eyes fixed on the pick's tip, unblinking.

lines.zh: 退到石柱后面，只露一只眼。
lines.en: Behind the pillar, showing one eye only.

lines.zh: 它要是抬手，我就钻缝。
lines.en: If that arm lifts, I squeeze into a crack.

lines.zh: 猜它下一步，比跑更重要。
lines.en: Guessing its next move matters more than speed.

lines.zh: 听它的呼吸，乱不乱。
lines.en: I listen to its breathing, steady or not.

lines.zh: 石块在我脚边，随时能踢。
lines.en: Loose stones at my feet, ready to kick.

lines.zh: 再等一会，它就会犯错。
lines.en: Wait a little longer; it will slip.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过来，缩小目标。
lines.en: I turn sideways and make a smaller target.

lines.zh: 钳子一夹，镐柄就歪了。
lines.en: One snap of my claw bends the pick's handle.

lines.zh: 横冲过去，用壳顶它膝盖。
lines.en: I charge sideways and ram its knee with my shell.

lines.zh: 别碰我的壳，那是钻石。
lines.en: Do not touch my shell; those are diamonds.

lines.zh: 腿一扫，把它绊在铁轨上。
lines.en: A sweep of my legs trips it onto the rails.

lines.zh: 这一钳是警告，下一钳不是。
lines.en: That pinch was a warning; the next is not.

lines.zh: 壳边削过去，像刀一样。
lines.en: My shell edge slices past like a blade.

lines.zh: 它后退了，我就再顶一下。
lines.en: It backs off; I butt it once more.

lines.zh: 硬壳撞硬甲，看谁先裂。
lines.en: Hard shell against hard plate; who cracks first?

lines.zh: 钳住它的袖口，往岩壁带。
lines.en: I grip its sleeve and drag it toward the wall.

lines.zh: 我打架只会一招，但很快。
lines.en: I know only one move, but I am fast.

lines.zh: 从深板岩缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out from between deepslate seams.

lines.zh: 这里的黑暗，正合我的壳色。
lines.en: This darkness suits the color of my shell.

lines.zh: 第一口气，满是石头味。
lines.en: My first breath is thick with stone dust.

lines.zh: 矿脉在下面，我感觉得到。
lines.en: The ore vein lies below; I can feel it.

lines.zh: 睁眼，只有蓝光和我。
lines.en: I open my eyes to blue light and nothing else.

lines.zh: 峡谷深处，落石还在响。
lines.en: Deep in the canyon, falling rocks still echo.

lines.zh: 壳还是软的，得先躲起来。
lines.en: My shell is still soft; I must hide first.

lines.zh: 头顶很高，岩壁很冷。
lines.en: The ceiling is high and the walls are cold.

lines.zh: 地下水在脚边，滴个不停。
lines.en: Groundwater drips beside me without pause.

lines.zh: 这一片矿，从此有我一份。
lines.en: This stretch of ore now has me in it.

lines.zh: 熔岩的热，透过壳烫进来。
lines.en: Lava's heat seeps straight through my shell.

lines.zh: 从岩台摔下，壳先着地。
lines.en: I fall from the ledge, shell landing first.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳缝，我呛住了。
lines.en: Water pours into my shell seams; I choke.

lines.zh: 矿洞里一声炸响，壳发烫。
lines.en: A blast in the tunnel leaves my shell hot.

lines.zh: 箭卡在壳缝里，拔不出来。
lines.en: The arrow is wedged in my shell seam.

lines.zh: 有什么东西钻进壳里，冷的。
lines.en: Something cold has slipped inside my shell.

lines.zh: 饿得壳都薄了，得找矿。
lines.en: Hungry enough that my shell thins; I need ore.

lines.zh: 雷劈在岩口，我整只壳发亮。
lines.en: Lightning hits the cave mouth; my shell glows.

lines.zh: 脚下没有岩层了，一直往下。
lines.en: No rock beneath me anymore, only falling.
